item.title: Senate State Affairs passes bill aimed at abortion pill advertising and distributing
item.description: (South Dakota Broadcasters Association) Senate State Affairs advanced a House-passed bill aimed at abortion-pill advertising and distribution on Wednesday. Supporters say it targets out-of-state pill providers and public ads. Opponents say it could intimidate patients during miscarriage care. item.title: Aberdeen Catholic School announces Elizabeth Raml hired as the next principal for Roncalli middle/high school
item.description: The Aberdeen Catholic School System has announced the hiring of Elizabeth Raml as the new middle school/high school principal at Aberdeen Roncalli. item.title: Homeland Security Secretary Krisi Noem fired
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem has been fired by President Donald Trump. The Administration has announced Oklahoma US Senator Markwayne Mullin will replace her.
